finalText:
**Not a one-day sign-off.** 1082 hits, 94 files. About 875 are plain JS names. Safe.

| Do not rename | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | frozen public contract |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js) WIRE values | 1 | public wire name |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk) | 12 | `vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 37 | applied history |
| SQL text in `repo/*.js` | 125 | real column name |
| payload key in `insert*` | 25 | stored JSON shape |
| [lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js) field | 2 | log consumers read it |

Next: rename JS names only. Wire and column changes need their own project.
